overall: The AG declined to review the claim that the Board wrongly kept an Inspector General complaint out of its minutes (not used at the meeting, so a public records matter), and found no violation in the chair requiring written questions.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board left a state Inspector General complaint, discussed at its June 16 meeting, out of the minutes instead of attaching it.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we decline to review this allegation and refer the complainant to the Supervisor of Records in the Secretary of the Commonwealth's Public Records Division.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the chair improperly required her to submit questions to the Board in writing rather than asking them during the July 14 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we find that it was not a violation of the Open Meeting Law for Chair Leach to require that questions be submitted to the Board in writing.
